name: AI Commit
author: gladkyWDSD
description: One bar button that commits every git repo with unsaved changes, with commit messages written by Claude. Preview and edit the messages, push, and undo from its panel.

barWidget.description: Click to commit every dirty git repo with a Claude-written message. Right-click to preview, push, or undo.

schema.label: Preview before committing
schema.description: A left click opens the panel with Claude's messages to check, edit, or untick before anything is committed.

schema.label: Hide when clean
schema.description: Hide the button while no repo has uncommitted changes.
